advancement.epic_relics.root.title: Epic Relics
advancement.epic_relics.root.description: Follow six relic paths. Original smithing recipes remain available; trials offer one sigil per player
advancement.epic_relics.clues.dragon_sig: Obtain a dragon head to uncover the Dragon Sight path
advancement.epic_relics.trials.dragon_si: Carry a dragon head and dragon breath together in the End. Rewards one Dragon Sight Sigil per player without consuming these materials. Smithing consumes the sigil; original recipes remain available
advancement.epic_relics.obtained.dragon_: Obtain the Dragon Sight Helmet. Both the original recipe and the sigil alternative are available
advancement.epic_relics.mastery.dragon_s: Wear the Dragon Sight Helmet in the Nether, the End and the Deep Dark
advancement.epic_relics.clues.skywing.de: Obtain elytra to uncover the Skywing path
advancement.epic_relics.trials.skywing.d: Glide continuously in the End for at least 10 seconds. Rewards one Skywing Sigil per player without consuming these materials. Smithing consumes the sigil; original recipes remain available
advancement.epic_relics.obtained.skywing: Obtain the Skywing Chestplate. Both the original recipe and the sigil alternative are available
Glide continuously for at least 10 seconds while wearing the Skywing Chestplate
advancement.epic_relics.clues.voidwalker: Obtain dragon breath to uncover the Voidwalker path
advancement.epic_relics.trials.voidwalke: Carry dragon breath and chorus fruit together in the End. Rewards one Voidwalker Sigil per player without consuming these materials. Smithing consumes the sigil; original recipes remain available
advancement.epic_relics.obtained.voidwal: Obtain the Voidwalker Leggings. Both the original recipe and the sigil alternative are available
advancement.epic_relics.mastery.voidwalk: Successfully use Void Step in the Overworld, the Nether and the End
advancement.epic_relics.clues.heavy_core: Obtain a heavy core to uncover the Heavy Core path
advancement.epic_relics.trials.heavy_cor: Carry a heavy core after personally unlocking an ominous vault. Rewards one Heavy Core Sigil per player without consuming these materials. Smithing consumes the sigil; original recipes remain available
advancement.epic_relics.obtained.heavy_c: Obtain the Heavy Core Boots. Both the original recipe and the sigil alternative are available
advancement.epic_relics.mastery.heavy_co: Damage a valid target with each stomp tier: a fall of 4–8, 8–16 and at least 16 blocks
advancement.epic_relics.clues.gravity.de: Obtain a mace to uncover the Gravity path
advancement.epic_relics.trials.gravity.d: Carry a mace after earning Over-Overkill (deal 50 hearts of damage in a single mace hit). Rewards one Gravity Sigil per player without consuming these materials. Smithing consumes the sigil; original recipes remain available
advancement.epic_relics.obtained.gravity: Obtain the Gravity Blade. Both the original recipe and the sigil alternative are available
Land a plunge attack with the Gravity Blade and slow a valid target with its gravity field
Obtain an echo shard to uncover the Resonance path
advancement.epic_relics.trials.resonance: Carry an echo shard in the Deep Dark after avoiding a sculk sensor by sneaking. Rewards one Resonance Sigil per player without consuming these materials. Smithing consumes the sigil; original recipes remain available
advancement.epic_relics.obtained.resonan: Obtain the Resonance Bow. Both the original recipe and the sigil alternative are available
advancement.epic_relics.mastery.resonanc: Apply Darkness with a dark arrow and successfully damage a target with a sonic boom
advancement.epic_relics.collection.title: The Six United
advancement.epic_relics.collection.descr: Carry all six final relics at once (equipped armor counts)
tooltip.epic_relics.sigil.origin: A reward from its exploration trial, earned once per player
tooltip.epic_relics.sigil.smithing: Smithing template: matching base + Nether Star; consumes this sigil
tooltip.epic_relics.sigil.legacy: The original smithing recipe remains available
